% Checks cases the fix of \pdfprimitive must not break: \pdfprimitive,
% pdftexcmds' copy \pdf@primitive, and expl3's \tex_primitive:D before a
% primitive that DVI mode allows, an expandable one in \ifnum and \edef,
% and \hbox, with pdftexcmds loaded in the preamble. pdftexcmds' other
% commands, which use the primitives, stay as they are.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{pdftexcmds}
\begin{document}
Strcmp: [\ifnum\pdfprimitive\pdfstrcmp{a}{a}=0 same\else different\fi].

Edef: \def\x{a}\edef\cmp{\pdfprimitive\pdfstrcmp{\x}{b}}\def\x{c}[\cmp].

Hbox: [\pdfprimitive\hbox{y}].

\makeatletter
Copy: [\ifnum\pdf@primitive\pdfstrcmp{a}{a}=0 same\else different\fi].

Copy edef: \def\x{b}\edef\cmp{\pdf@primitive\pdfstrcmp{\x}{a}}\def\x{0}[\cmp].

Copy hbox: [\pdf@primitive\hbox{z}].

Command: [\pdf@strcmp{a}{c}] [\pdf@escapehex{A}].
\makeatother

\ExplSyntaxOn
Expl:~[\int_compare:nNnTF { \tex_primitive:D \pdfstrcmp {a}{a} } = 0 {same} {different}].

\tl_set:Nn \l_tmpb_tl {a}
\tl_set:Ne \l_tmpa_tl { \tex_primitive:D \pdfstrcmp { \l_tmpb_tl } {b} }
\tl_set:Nn \l_tmpb_tl {c}
Expl~edef:~[\tl_use:N \l_tmpa_tl].
\ExplSyntaxOff
\end{document}
